assets.purpose: Request → Response Lifecycle
assets.alt_text: Request → Response Lifecycle: Client sends request; Flask matches URL + method; View validates and works; Response is returned.
assets.caption: Trace one request ID through the stages; teardown hooks are not a substitute for handling the response.
assets.source_license: Original CodeLeaf instructional SVG, authored for this course; no external artwork.

assets.purpose: Render a Dynamic Template
assets.alt_text: Render a Dynamic Template: View prepares trusted context; Jinja evaluates template; HTML response is built; Browser receives markup.
assets.caption: Pass only the data a template needs and never mark untrusted user content as safe.
assets.source_license: Original CodeLeaf instructional SVG, authored for this course; no external artwork.

assets.purpose: Post / Redirect / Get
assets.alt_text: Post / Redirect / Get: Browser submits POST; Server validates + saves; Server redirects to GET; Browser displays feedback.
assets.caption: PRG reduces accidental resubmission; it does not make a write operation idempotent by itself.
assets.source_license: Original CodeLeaf instructional SVG, authored for this course; no external artwork.

assets.purpose: Factory + Blueprints
assets.alt_text: Factory + Blueprints: Load environment config; Create Flask app instance; Initialize extensions; Register blueprints + return.
assets.caption: Keep extension objects reusable across app instances and register them inside the factory.
assets.source_license: Original CodeLeaf instructional SVG, authored for this course; no external artwork.

assets.purpose: Database Transaction Boundary
assets.alt_text: Database Transaction Boundary: Validate request values; Begin unit of work; Commit on success; Rollback on failure.
assets.caption: Pair query parameters with transaction boundaries; always clean up connections and sessions.
assets.source_license: Original CodeLeaf instructional SVG, authored for this course; no external artwork.

assets.purpose: Identity Is Not Permission
assets.alt_text: Identity Is Not Permission: Receive credentials; Verify identity safely; Resolve account + role; Check ownership on each action.
assets.caption: Check authorization on the server for every object; hiding a button is not access control.
assets.source_license: Original CodeLeaf instructional SVG, authored for this course; no external artwork.

assets.purpose: REST Resource Lifecycle
assets.alt_text: REST Resource Lifecycle: Receive method + URL; Validate body + query; Apply authorized change; Return JSON + status.
assets.caption: Document permitted fields, error shape and pagination behavior; never leak internal tracebacks.
assets.source_license: Original CodeLeaf instructional SVG, authored for this course; no external artwork.

assets.purpose: Safer File Upload Pipeline
assets.alt_text: Safer File Upload Pipeline: Limit request size; Validate allowed content; Generate server-side key; Store privately + authorize.
assets.caption: An extension allowlist is only one signal; avoid serving attacker-controlled uploads as active HTML.
assets.source_license: Original CodeLeaf instructional SVG, authored for this course; no external artwork.

assets.purpose: Flask Async in a WSGI App
assets.alt_text: Flask Async in a WSGI App: Request occupies worker; View awaits compatible I/O; View returns response; Use queue for durable jobs.
assets.caption: Do not rely on detached tasks for durable work; configure async dependencies and test extension compatibility.
assets.source_license: Original CodeLeaf instructional SVG, authored for this course; no external artwork.

assets.purpose: Test Arrange → Act → Assert
assets.alt_text: Test Arrange → Act → Assert: Arrange app + test config; Act with test client; Assert status + body; Reset state / close resources.
assets.caption: Prefer isolated fixtures and exercise both expected behavior and failure boundaries.
assets.source_license: Original CodeLeaf instructional SVG, authored for this course; no external artwork.

assets.purpose: Trust Boundaries
assets.alt_text: Trust Boundaries: Identify external input; Validate type + size; Authenticate + authorize; Encode output + log safely.
assets.caption: Layer protections; CSRF tokens, cookies, CORS and authentication solve different problems.
assets.source_license: Original CodeLeaf instructional SVG, authored for this course; no external artwork.

assets.purpose: Measure Before Optimizing
assets.alt_text: Measure Before Optimizing: Choose a realistic workload; Measure latency + resource use; Locate costly work; Change one factor + compare.
assets.caption: Keep the dataset and load profile reproducible; shared cache state and database plans affect results.
assets.source_license: Original CodeLeaf instructional SVG, authored for this course; no external artwork.

assets.purpose: Production Request Path
assets.alt_text: Production Request Path: TLS + reverse proxy; Production WSGI workers; Flask app + extensions; Database / cache + telemetry.
assets.caption: Do not expose Flask debug mode; trust forwarded headers only from the known proxy chain.
assets.source_license: Original CodeLeaf instructional SVG, authored for this course; no external artwork.

assets.purpose: Observe → Diagnose → Recover
assets.alt_text: Observe → Diagnose → Recover: Collect bounded telemetry; Detect a useful signal; Triage + mitigate; Verify recovery + record learning.
assets.caption: Keep passwords, tokens, full session cookies and unnecessary personal data out of logs.
assets.source_license: Original CodeLeaf instructional SVG, authored for this course; no external artwork.

assets.purpose: Extension Initialization
assets.alt_text: Extension Initialization: Define extension object; Read namespaced config; Initialize app instance; Verify lifecycle + teardown.
assets.caption: Prefer maintained extensions with documented compatibility and a clear exit strategy.
assets.source_license: Original CodeLeaf instructional SVG, authored for this course; no external artwork.

assets.alt_text: Flask Learning Roadmap: Fundamentals + HTTP; Templates + modular apps; Data + identity + APIs; Testing, security, deployment + internals.
assets.caption: Complete exercises alongside their lessons; production readiness requires testing, security, deployment and recovery evidence.
